006package dev.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.INodeItem;
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
012
013/**
014 * Represents a constraint that allows a configurable message.
015 *
016 * @since 2.0.0
017 */
018public interface IConfigurableMessageConstraint extends IConstraint {
019
020  /**
021   * A message to emit when the constraint is violated. Allows embedded Metapath
022   * expressions using the syntax {@code \{ metapath \}}.
023   *
024   * @return the message if defined or {@code null} otherwise
025   */
026  @Nullable
027  String getMessage();
028
029  /**
030   * Generate a violation message using the provided item and dynamic context for
031   * inline Metapath value insertion.
032   *
033   * @param item
034   *          the target Metapath item to use as the focus for Metapath evaluation
035   * @param context
036   *          the dynamic context for Metapath evaluation
037   * @return the message
038   * @throws ConstraintInitializationException
039   *           if a custom message is not defined, which will occur if this method
040   *           is called while {@link #getMessage()} returns {@code null}
041   * @throws ConstraintValidationException
042   *           if the custom message contains a Metapath expression that is
043   *           invalid or if the expression failed to evaluate
044   */
045  @NonNull
046  String generateMessage(@NonNull INodeItem item, @NonNull DynamicContext context) throws ConstraintValidationException;
047}
